g.text: 100% YouTube API (ToS Section III.E) Compliant Client-Side Playback & Sub-Track Metadata Indexing Pipeline
Visual cue markers rendered from PostgreSQL metadata.
Direct timeline seeking & boundary segment highlights.
✓ Zero raw PCM audio decoding (sandboxed iframe safety)
Tier 1: Mandatory objective preset buttons (Isolation, Inst, Section).
Tier 2: Collapsible secondary contextual descriptor chips.
✓ Instant 10s segment audio preview removes ambiguity
Client loop listener returns playhead to start_time at end_time.
Rough auditioning loop for evaluating musical sampling potential.
Single-player timestamp bookmarking utility while digging.
Stores sub-track cue points without consuming local drive storage.
✓ Preserves "why" a sample was saved for future studio recall
❌ ZERO audio scraping or stream downloading
❌ ZERO server-side media caching or raw PCM storage
❌ ZERO bypassing of graphical embedded player UI
Eliminates copyright infringement risks and bandwidth costs.
Dispatched via official PostMessage / IFrame events:
Video GOP keyframe spacing induces 1.0–2.0s seek latency.
Formally specified in Acceptance Criteria 2 & NFR-02.
✓ Evaluated via Wizard-of-Oz testing in Midterm 2 roadmap
Audio and video bits stream directly from Google CDN to user browser.
Platform operates with zero media egress / ingress server bills.
Sandboxed cross-origin iframe isolates authentication tokens
and prevents unauthorized client-side audio rip injection.
Zero audio payloads. Stored records consist strictly of pointers:
Controlled enum validation prevents tag pollution:
Community tag appeals and erroneous timestamp flags
are audited via admin dashboard (NFR-03: latency < 200ms).
Private crate table isolation per user:
Producers maintain private smart crates without publishing.
If H3 fails (gatekeeping), platform smoothly transitions
to 100% Personal Crate-Digging Workspace with zero code rewrite.
Replaces opaque black-box AI scores with explainable overlap:
✓ 4/4 Match: Exact isolation + instrument + section match
✓ 3/4 Match: Instrument + isolation match across catalog
Zero fake similarity percentages (no '98% AI Match' claims)
Users listen to a sample segment, click its preset chips,
and immediately receive an associative recommendation feed
of matching sub-track cue points in unfamiliar recordings.
No typing text queries from scratch; discovery follows active ears.
Solves the cold-start catalog challenge with ZERO audio processing:
1. YouTube Data API v3 Chapter Ingestion:
Extracts timestamps from video descriptions & chapter markers
Maps track musician credits (e.g., Rhodes, Saxophone, Bass) to presets
✓ Populates initial catalog landmarks prior to community scaling
System engineering boundaries mapped to Course Guideline Non-Functional Requirements (NFR-01 to NFR-03).
Zero Media Storage & Bandwidth Egress Costs
